nodes.title: Prepare H3 Continuation
widgets_values: Continue the previous shot naturally while preserving identity and appearance from <Picture 1>, with coherent motion, ambience and scene continuity. Synchronize visible mouth articulation and speech/singing performance to the supplied audio timing; preserve the existing performance in the context.

This workflow generates the **future with Ref2VA**, regardless of whether the source segment was FL2VA or Ref2VA. The protected joint-AV latent prefix carries hard continuity; active packet references provide semantic/identity conditioning for the unknown future.

H3 Sampling owns the acceleration adapter and records the actual LoRA hash. Turbo 4 uses the matching FL2V v1.1 768p or Ref2V recipe. Select Standard - 20 steps for stock sampling: no separate LoRA toggle is needed.

For creative LoRAs, apply them after Sampling and pass the complete ordered applied LoRA list to Pack.
nodes.title: Ref2VA Turbo 4-step / stock 20-step fallback
Continuation controls
widgets_values:
**Source family:** may be FL2VA or Ref2VA; source must be a direct H3 sampler-output latent.

**Future family:** this workflow is fixed to Ref2VA. Select the identity image below; it is upserted as Picture 1 while other references remain available.

**End frame:** optional AddGuide endpoint can be combined with Ref2VA references because it targets the future timeline, not the preserved prefix.

**Latent stitch:** keep video/audio handover equal on exact shared AV boundaries (39, 90, 141, ...). Mixed REF/FL chains are allowed only with exact parent latent revision lineage.

AUDIO TIMELINE: Continue source reads the next window of the original full soundtrack. New audio starts after the preserved context; connect an AUDIO loader to New audio on Generate H3 Video (or select a reference explicitly). New audio start (s) skips a lead-in. New audio fit applies only when introducing a track. No source remainder means silence. Save each committed MMH3 and load it for the next continuation. In F05 Video Stitch use Auto Seamless or Cut: recorded context is removed once. Crossfade changes the clock and is blocked for this protected chain.

Video Settings length includes the inherited context. New visible duration = target duration minus context duration (normally 39/24 = 1.625 seconds).
